title: Show destination names while draining parked outputs
summary: Update pending-publish drain progress display to show the intended final destination filename instead of the internal timestamp/GUID parked payload name.
reason: The operator-facing progress card should show the clean final publish name while preserving the parked payload and manifest names for recovery and diagnostics.
behavior_before: Publishing parked outputs displayed the local PendingServerPush payload leaf, including timestamp and transaction GUID prefixes.
behavior_after: Publishing parked outputs displays the manifest server_out leaf when available while keeping the progress file path pointed at the local parked payload.
rollback_plan: Revert the pending push progress display-name fallback and the focused safety assertion. This does not require parked payload, manifest, copy, reveal, or cleanup rollback because those paths are unchanged.
notes: Display-only progress overlay; parked payload names, manifest names, drain trust checks, copy path, final reveal path, and cleanup path remain unchanged.
